messages.content:
A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.
Which harmonised standard (EN number) gives presumption of conformity for vehicle servicing lifts placed on the market from 20 January 2027 under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: {"lookups": ["Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Annex I machinery list \"vehicle servicing lifts\" \"sollevatori per la manutenzione dei veicoli\" \"ascensori per autoveicoli\"", "Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 harmonised standards presumption of conformity \"norme armonizzate\" \"presunzione di conformità\" Article 40 \"EN 1493\"", "Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Article 54 application date \"20 January 2027\" \"a decorrere dal 20 gennaio 2027\" placed on the market", "Official Journal list of harmonised standards for Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 \"Gazzetta ufficiale dell'Unione europea\" \"elenco delle norme armonizzate\" \"EN 1493\" vehicle lifts"]}
